tidbit: Did you know… about 11,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
LeapThought and Google Cloud partner to secure critical building infrastructure with sovereign artificial intelligence. Confirmed by 巴士的報: the collaboration offers data control and natural-language insights.
Nvidia's 64GB DGX Spark launches at $4,999, supporting up to 100B parameters. Reported by TechRepublic: the system can be clustered for 200B model support.
Qlik brings governed business context and analytics workflows to Claude through Anthropic's directory. Reported by AiThority: the integration enables Claude to access governed business context via MCP.
Pennsylvania lawmakers push for artificial intelligence ad disclosure after deepfakes rise. Reported by MyChesCo: the bill remains stalled in the Senate.
Agile Robots and Nvidia launch Agile ONE SN, a research robot bundling Nvidia's robotics stack. Reported by TechRepublic: the robot is set for early 2027 release.
Free every hour.
